gaps: Wear as biography broke the first framing: it retains a record, but of use, not time, and a hoarded coin reads young. Then every other kept item turned out to need something the object does not carry: a known rate, a starting ratio, a reference corpus, a stipulated rate, a throughput. Readable time is a comparison between two states, and merely-passed time left no second state. Breath two asks where the second state lives.
accepted: Ratchet count: a periodic forcing leaves one increment per cycle, as a tree lays one ring per year and a lake one varve per thaw, so a reader who counts learns how many cycles passed and, from each increment's width, how each cycle went; without a periodic forcing a layered thing is a pile to be ordered, not a count to be read.

Half-life ledger: a memoryless transformation at a known rate turns a starting ratio into an elapsed time, as radiocarbon reads the years since a tree stopped exchanging carbon with the air; it dates the moment the thing was sealed off from its reservoir, not the thing, so a reused beam dates a forest's death and not the house.

Wear as biography: contact with users erodes a thing in proportion to handling, as a coin loses its relief and a stair its middle, so the reading is use-time rather than calendar time; a hoarded coin reads young for its mint year, and that disagreement, not the wear itself, is the information.

Larder countdown: a stock consumed at a rate reads as the time remaining before it is gone, as a winter's grain or a candle reads a deadline rather than an elapsed duration; the deadline is conditional on consumption, so it can be moved by eating less, which no elapsed time can.

Queue clock: the length of a line reads as the wait of the next arrival, given the throughput, as the line at the mill tells the whole town the same afternoon; the reading is shared and reflexive, since those who read it as too long leave and shorten it, so this clock is changed by being read.

Contract calendar: a stipulated rate applied to a stipulated origin makes an amount owed read as elapsed time, as interest is the only calendar a village keeps; nothing physical ages, so a dispute about how long it has been becomes a dispute about the rate, and the duration is enforceable exactly to the extent the agreement is.

Drift against corpus: a shared, unreversed drift of usage places a document at a position in a sequence of other documents, as spelling and letterforms date a manuscript; it yields position and coevality, never duration, because nobody knows the rate at which a language moves.

One-way rite: an act that can happen only once partitions time into before and after, as a coronation, an initiation, or the breaking of a jar's seal does, so a life reads as a vector of which irreversibles have occurred; it says which side of a threshold one stands on and never how far from it.

Free-running hunger: an internal oscillator entrained to an external cycle keeps its phase after the cue is removed, as a ground squirrel in a windowless room still fattens in autumn, so a body reads where in the year it is without seeing the year; it reads a phase, never a count, and in the dark it slowly drifts, which is how one knows it is a memory of the cycle and not the cycle.

residue.item: Sundial shadow: the height of the sun read off a stick, the model every clock imitates.
residue.why: Rejected: retains nothing; cover the sun and the ground forgets. It is the world's clock, not time written into a state, and it became the boundary case.

residue.item: Tally stick: notches cut once per event.
residue.why: Rejected: retains a count, but one a counter made, so it is a record and a device; rings differ because nobody counted them into the tree.

residue.item: Ripening: a fruit or a pregnancy reads as time until a terminus.
residue.why: Rejected: the same staged program as Succession dial, read from the other end; direction of reading is a property of the reader, not a second mechanism.

residue.item: Bladder alarm: a homeostatic accumulator that reads itself and compels the reading.
residue.why: Held as residue: an accumulator since reset like the Half-life ledger, distinct only in that the reading is compulsory; whether compulsion belongs to how time is written or how it is read is the best unresolved seed.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy of dating methods; one object can carry several of these at once (a coin has a mint year, wear, and patina), and the list makes no claim to cover every way a state retains time.
The itinerary orders where the comparison state is kept, not accuracy, antiquity, or reliability; map edges are conditional authored claims, not measured dependencies.
Lattice of rites is invented: no claim that any society orders age this way. Vector clock is a real engineering construct; the passage drawn between them is an authored analogy, not a derivation.

Physical rates and fluxes (half-lives, cosmogenic dose, insect succession) are cited as illustrations of a mechanism, not certified; forensic and geochronological practice is far more conditional than one sentence can carry.
The item type excludes the world's own cycles (sun, tide, season) by fiat, because they retain nothing; a different item type would admit them and would produce a different list.

gaps: The second state can live in a peer (Fingerprint match), in a partial order of peers (Vector clock), in the live present (Lag as ruler, Frozen dictionary), or only in the reader's expectation (Milk on the step), which the first framing obscured because absence writes nothing into anything. The invented Lattice of rites turned out to sit between two observed members, One-way rite and Vector clock, so the passage bit → partial order → causal order became the map's spine. Unresolved: whether phase (Free-running hunger) is a second state at all or a retained copy of the world's clock.
accepted: Lag as ruler: a state preserved in transit arrives as old as the journey, as starlight and a postmark do, so the reader learns how stale the news is and what the source was, not what it is; nothing accumulates in the thing, the delay is the whole reading, and it is silent about the source's present.

Superposition: things that can only be added on top order themselves by stacking, as sediment, an inbox, and a laundry heap each put the later above the earlier; it yields before and after within one pile, nothing across piles, and nothing about how long.

Succession dial: a triggered program of stages, each requiring the last, reads time since the trigger, as the insects on a corpse name the days since death; the same stage means different durations in July and January, so it is a duration only while the temperature record survives and collapses to an ordering of stages once that record is lost.

Fingerprint match: an irregular pattern in the thing is matched to the same pattern in a reference of known date, as a plank's ring widths lock onto a master chronology or an ash layer onto a named eruption; it yields an absolute date with no rate and no counting, but only where a reference exists, and a pattern too regular to be unique cannot be matched at all.

Frozen dictionary: a mind that stops updating at departure is dated, on return, by the gap between what it knows and the live present, as the returnee who still uses the old street name and the old prices; it dates the severance rather than the person, and the set of missed changes is an inventory of the interval, not merely its length.

Milk on the step: an expected cadence that goes unanswered reads as a bound on time since the last presence, as bottles accumulating on a doorstep give a lower bound and an unfired dead man's switch an upper bound; nothing is written into the absent person, the cadence does the counting, and the reading is a bound, never a value.

Vector clock: each participant counts its own irreversibles and learns the others' counts only when messages arrive, so events order by what could have influenced what, as Lamport and vector timestamps do in a distributed system; for some pairs it reports that no order exists, which is a fact about causation no clock can state, and it never yields a duration.

Lattice of rites: in an invented society whose only marks of age are unrepeatable rites that may be taken in more than one order, one person is older than another only when every rite of the second is a rite of the first, so incomparable elders exist and precedence between them must be negotiated rather than measured; a society with one fixed sequence of rites has a line, not this lattice.

Sunburn of stones: an ambient flux accumulates in whatever lies open to it, as cosmic rays build nuclides in a boulder from the day a glacier uncovered it, so the dose reads the moment of uncovering; it dates exposure rather than existence, and a stone rolled onto its other face reads as newborn.

residue.item: Tide line: the wet mark on a pier plus the present water level.
residue.why: Rejected: the mark retains only a maximum; reading the phase needs the live sea, which is the world's clock again.

residue.item: Deli ticket and seniority roster: an assigned serial number as ordering.
residue.why: Rejected: an assigned counter is the degenerate totally ordered case of Vector clock, and its wait reading is the Queue clock; nothing survives that the two members do not already carry.

residue.item: Old menu prices: inflation as a dated reference series.
residue.why: Rejected: drift matched against a reference that happens to carry dates, so it is Drift against corpus plus Fingerprint match, not a third mechanism.

residue.item: Vividness dating: the fadedness of a memory as its age.
residue.why: Held as seed: forgetting curves are real, but the rate is so person- and event-dependent that the reading yields ordering at best; it may belong with Drift against corpus once a reference is named.

neighbors.separating_case: A corpse and a beam from the same fire. The beam's radiocarbon reads years since the tree died, indifferent to everything that happened after and to the climate it lay in. The insects on the corpse read days since death, but the same stage means different durations in July and January; lose the temperature record and the succession reading falls to an ordering of stages, while the decay reading keeps its duration.

checks.boundary_case: The shadow of a stick, the sundial's principle, tells the hour but retains nothing: cover the sun and the ground forgets. The item type requires a state that carries time forward, so the sky's cycles are the world's clock and not a member; the ground squirrel is admitted only because its phase survives in the dark. A tally stick is also out, from the other side: it retains a count, but one that a counter made, so it is a record and a device.
checks.form_inference: Three relations the itinerary conceals. A dependency: Half-life ledger, placed second, borrows its origin from Ratchet count, placed first, so the rate clock is not independent of the count clock. A passage between levels: One-way rite becomes Lattice of rites becomes Vector clock, a single bit becoming a partial order becoming a causal order, with the invented member sitting between two observed ones. An incompatibility: Lattice of rites and Contract calendar cannot run the same society, because a rate needs a total order of durations. The Milk on the step to Frozen dictionary edge adds a handoff at return, where a bound becomes an inventory.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Every admitted item names both a mechanism of retention and the inference it licenses that a clock does not: use rather than time, the moment of sealing or uncovering, a phase, a deadline, an ordering with holes, a severance, a bound. The invented lattice keeps its strangeness rather than being domesticated into age grades.

next_crossfield_opening: Absence that counts: connect Milk on the step with traces-of-the-unlived's Missing alarm, which needs a clock to detect a nonarrival; ask whether a cadence can replace the clock entirely, and what changes when the expectation itself is the only second state.

gaps: The item type excludes built timekeepers but the map did not enforce its own exclusion: a postmark (stamped date) in Lag as ruler, a dead man's switch (timer) in Milk on the step, Lamport timestamps credited with reporting concurrency in Vector clock, and a village computing its own interest in Contract calendar; and the tally-stick ruling threw out what Vector clock admits. The exclusion had to be applied to the map's own examples: a tally of events is in, a tally of days is out.
accepted: Sunburn of stones: an ambient flux accumulates in whatever lies open to it, as cosmic rays build nuclides in a boulder from the day a glacier uncovered it, so the dose reads the moment of uncovering; it dates time in the open rather than existence, so a thick boulder rolled to put its shielded underside skyward reads as newborn, and one buried for a millennium and dug out again reads its exposed years, not its age, which no decay clock can be made to do.

Free-running hunger: an internal oscillator entrained to an external cycle keeps its phase after the cue is removed, as a ground squirrel in a windowless room still fattens in autumn, so a body reads where in the year it is without seeing the year; it reads a phase, never a count, and because it drifts in the dark at its own period, the gap between body and sky when the sky is seen again reads how long the cue was gone, a reading a clock that was never entrained cannot give.

Vector clock: each participant counts its own irreversibles and learns the others' counts only when messages arrive, so events order by what could have influenced what, as vector timestamps do in a distributed system; for some pairs it reports that no order exists, which is a fact about causation no clock can state and no single tally, whether a Lamport timestamp or a notched stick, can state either, and it never yields a duration.

Contract calendar: a stipulated rate applied to a stipulated origin makes an amount owed read as elapsed time, as interest would in a village that kept no calendar but its debts; nothing physical ages and the amount was written by whatever calendar the parties had, so the duration lives only in the agreement, a dispute about how long it has been becomes a dispute about the rate, and the duration is enforceable exactly to the extent the agreement is.

Drift against corpus: a shared, unreversed drift of usage places a document at a position in a sequence of other documents, as spelling and letterforms date a manuscript; it yields position and coevality, never duration, because no trusted rate exists for how fast a language moves.

Lag as ruler: a state preserved in transit arrives as old as the journey, as starlight and a letter carried up a road of known length do, so the reader learns how stale the news is and what the source was, not what it is; nothing accumulates in the thing, the delay is the whole reading, and it is silent about the source's present.

Milk on the step: an expected cadence that goes unanswered reads time since the last presence, as bottles accumulating on a doorstep count the days since anyone took one in and a houseplant not yet wilted bounds them from above; nothing is written into the absent person, a neighbor's cadence does the counting, and where nothing accumulates, as with the Sunday call that did not come, the reading falls from a count to a bound held only in the reader's expectation.

residue.item: Wear as biography (critic flagged, not repaired): the hoarded coin's disagreement is read against a mint year, a stamped date.
residue.why: Held as written on the critic's own ruling: the Wear → Half-life ledger edge recruits a sealed-date reading in place of the stamp, so the item stands, but its illustration still leans on a device.

residue.item: Milk on the step → Frozen dictionary edge label
residue.why: Not a cut: lightly corrected from 'a lower bound becomes an inventory' to 'a count of days becomes an inventory' so the edge matches the repaired item, in which bottles count days and only the unanswered call falls to a bound.

limits: The exclusion of built timekeepers turns on intent to be read as time, not on physics (unmarked candle in, marked candle out; tally of events in, tally of days out), which places Contract calendar exactly on the line.
seed: Superposition says it yields nothing across piles, and Vector clock is exactly the across-piles order, yet no edge joins them. An object that moved from pile A to pile B is a message: everything below it in B is after everything below its origin in A. That is how an intrusive sherd cross-dates two middens, and it makes stratigraphy across sites a vector clock with strata as counts and moved objects as messages. Write that edge, then ask what the incomparable pairs are: layers in two sites that no object ever crossed between, whose order no digging can settle.
